stories.story_fr: Le bénéfice par action GAAP du premier trimestre FY25 s'établit à 2,77 $.
stories.story_en: GAAP earnings per share for Q1 FY25 is $2.77.
stories.quote: preliminary fiscal 2025 first quarter GAAP earnings per share ( EPS ) of $2.77

stories.story_fr: Le BPA ajusté de 2,86 $ dépasse la fourchette de prévision de 2,75 à 2,85 $.
stories.story_en: Adjusted EPS of $2.86 exceeds the prior guidance range of $2.75 to $2.85.
stories.quote: preliminary fiscal 2025 first quarter adjusted EPS of $2.86... exceeds the top end of the Company’s previous fiscal 2025 first quarter adjusted EPS guidance of $2.75 to $2.85

stories.story_fr: Publication des résultats complets prévue le 6 février 2025 avant l'ouverture du marché.
stories.story_en: Full results will be released on February 6, 2025 before market open.
stories.quote: The Company will release its full Q1FY25 financial results prior to market open on Thursday, February 6, 2025
